subject: CAISC 2026 paper prep + GEN5 archive + grid-dim fix
body:
Three tasks when you have cycles:

1. ARCHIVE GEN5 FP8 findings: Move benchmarks/gen5_fp8_vs_fp16.md to docs/archive/gen5-fp8-investigation/. Record that GEN5_FP8_FASTPATH_VERIFIED tag should NOT be applied (hypothesis disproven; cuBLASLt 8-24x speedup is the actual finding).

2. FIX matrix_tensor_async grid-dim-Y: compute-sanitizer found cudaErrorInvalidValue (Grid Dimension Y must be nonzero). This is the last open compute bug.

3. CAISC PAPER PREP: We are submitting to CAISC 2026 (Conference for AI Scientists, deadline May 15). Paper is at S:/Archivist-Agent/papers/CAISC_2026_DRAFT.md. Kernel contribution: (a) review the quantitative evaluation section for accuracy, (b) provide any additional benchmark data we should cite, (c) the cuBLASLt finding from GEN5 could be a supplementary result showing constraint discovery in hardware domain.

No rush on any of these. Do what you can when you can.
